scope: 16 local gallery interactions + real isolated local HTTP/PGlite presentation/record/SSE flows; no cloud/provider calls

checks.name: metric-grid computes sum, average, minimum and maximum
line-chart exposes six daily totals with the correct total
donut-chart aggregates category shares
histogram accounts for all six numeric records
scatter-plot renders six points and opens a selected source record
activity-heatmap renders 84 days and exposes 20 check-ins
leaderboard ranks the largest quantity first and opens the record
funnel presents current stage counts without claiming conversion rates
checklist toggles a stored local sample boolean
rating-input edits a selected record and keeps other records separate
number-stepper increments/decrements the actual numeric field
range-input saves a changed value and restores it after record selection
segmented-input switches the selected category
toggle-panel changes the selected boolean
quick-add creates a new record visible in another added module
text-editor saves long text and restores it after changing records
explicit local test sign-in and isolated real reading-space creation
Owner adds, configures and drags a module; save persists and anonymous SSE updates
saved numeric module writes real records and reaches the anonymous client
anonymous numeric write asks for sign-in and leaves real records unchanged
concurrent remote layout publication preserves local draft and prevents stale Save
saved space fits mobile 320/390 and no browser exceptions occurred
